selection_basis: Documented 2011-2012 coverage; user-prescribed calendar windows, never model scores
windows: Half-open target-label windows; training is 2011 calendar year before readiness exclusion
time_semantics: Naive source-calendar interval-start labels by convention, not verified UTC/timezone/DST or elapsed-hour semantics
readiness_qualification: Hypothetical immediate aggregate availability; train target t allowed only if t+1h <= first validation issuance. Not an operational source guarantee.
feature_policy: Only requested target calendar fields; no weather, season, holiday, workingday, raw IDs/date/year, target or target components, lags or interactions
fit_cadence: Once at first development issuance; frozen through validation
primary_metric: MAE, rentals per represented hourly observation; median main reference
diagnostics: First 48 development records and all 24 target-hour slices; signed residual=observed-predicted; raw predictions, no clipping/rounding or post-score feature changes
final_test: No fitting, predictions, scores or target-specific diagnostics until later #25 selection/report gate
prior_access: #19 whole-source mechanical schema/domain/component integrity checks read all count fields before this protocol; final targets are not literally unseen
